Starting cards as posted under Starting: the Objective, Alderaan, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Prepared Defenses, A Million Voices Crying Out, Oppressive Enforcement and Something Special Planned For Them; these count toward the total.
Oppressive Enforcement, Come Here You Big Coward and Secret Plans are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields).
Systems and the Docking Bay dested the Dark pages: Alderaan (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Yavin 4 (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark).

Posted 'Iggy With Gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Bobby With Gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (the bounty hunter pair 'with gun'); 'Grand Moff Wilhuf Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Captain Godheart' dested Captain Godherdt; 'Chimera' dested Chimaera; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse.
